purpose: Machine truth for whether named production-blueprint gates are actually wired strongly enough to authorize execution. A prose requirement is not an executable gate.

EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS.gap: Not proven as a mandatory precondition on every production-readiness claim.

CLAIM_STATE_SEPARATION.gap: Claim taxonomy exists, but no universal runtime gate proves PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/live-vs-fixture separation before mission progression.

NO_MUTATION.gap: Mission runner historically ignored mutation_allowed/owner semantics; production mission guard must enforce them.

ARCHITECTURE_COMPLETE.gap: Architecture/manufacturing-plan checks exist but are not yet universally bound to production mission execution.

NO_INVENTION.gap: Detector exists; production mission execution still needs mandatory current-blueprint binding.

CONDUCTOR_INTENT_FIDELITY.gap: Conductor/consensus gate can run advisory unless strict mode is enabled; advisory is not hard enforcement.

CURRENT_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION.gap: Typed EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED record is specified but not found as the mandatory mutation authority in the live mission runner.

BLUEPRINT_HASH_MATCH.gap: Blueprint-content hash binding is specified but not found on the live mission mutation path.

SCOPE_MATCH.gap: Sandbox boundary is enforced, but it is not equivalent to current authorized-slice/hash scope.

SENTRY_PREBUILD.gap: Current step SENTRY primarily verifies after write; a current prebuild authorization predicate is not universally mandatory.

FOUNDER_NOT_ROUTER.gap: Doctrine is hard; recovery code still allowed Council execution to be opt-in by environment, so runtime parity is incomplete.

SECURITY_BOUNDARY_DEFINED.gap: Security contract exists; universal runtime interception is not yet proven.

SECURITY_SCOPE.gap: Scoped-capability contract is not yet proven on every external/overlay action path.

SENTRY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFY.gap: Some verification is mechanically separate, but the global enforcement-truth receipt admits same-script verdict generation; production proof must use an independent evidence path.

REVERSIBILITY.gap: No universal reversible-action gate was found on the production Overlay action path.

SCOPED_ACTION_AUTHORIZATION.gap: Task Authorization Envelope exists for Taloa runtime; proof is still needed that the exact LifeRE-through-Overlay action path cannot bypass it.

RUNTIME_TRUTH.gap: Layer-B path is truthful; broader LifeRE production state still needs one consolidated current-state receipt.

LIFERE_ACCEPTANCE_PASS.gap: Prior acceptance exists, but the deployment-closure mission still needs a fresh exact-revision production acceptance gate.

PRODUCTION_HEALTH.gap: Health/readiness probes exist; exact release-candidate health binding is not yet mission-scoped.

SECURITY_PASS.gap: No single production-release security receipt is currently mandatory for this mission.

GOVERNANCE_EVIDENCE_COMPLETE.gap: Global enforcement-truth receipt currently tolerates 145 baseline findings and can still report CLEAN; that is insufficient for a production mission.

READY_TO_DEPLOY_CURRENT.gap: Typed readiness receipt for exact revision not yet implemented.

EXACT_HASH_MATCH.gap: Deployment path has no mission-specific exact accepted-hash requirement proven here.

CANONICAL_DEPLOY_PATH.gap: Canonical deploy service exists; mission-specific authorization binding remains unproven.

ROLLBACK_READY.gap: No mandatory rollback-readiness receipt found for this mission.

POSTDEPLOY_LIVE_PASS.gap: Layer B can run post-deploy, but exact deployed revision binding is not yet part of its receipt.

EXACT_DEPLOYED_HASH.gap: Layer-B receipt does not currently bind its proof to a deployed commit hash.

LESSONS_CAPTURED.gap: Learning doctrine exists; no mission hard gate proves every material failure received causal/prevention disposition before completion.

NO_FAKE_GREEN.gap: Detection exists, but known dormant enforcement debt can still be baseline-tolerated and reported CLEAN.

production_rule: A required gate with status other than WIRED_HARD blocks execution authorization unless the blueprint explicitly provides a narrower equivalent hard mechanism and the registry is updated with evidence.
